papers.title: Effect of selective laser melting process parameters on microstructural and mechanical properties of TiC–NiCr cermet

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究TiC-NiCr金属陶瓷的SLM工艺参数对性能的影响，不涉及生物医用植入体或其力学适配。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant applications, stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration; it focuses on cermet for wear-resistant industrial use.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM参数对TiC-NiCr金属陶瓷组织和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数进行SLM成形，并进行显微组织和力学性能表征。
summary_zh.result: 工艺参数显著影响硬度和耐磨性，优化参数可获得高致密、高硬度样品。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜、XRD、硬度测试和磨损试验进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of TiC-NiCr cermet.
summary_en.method: SLM was conducted with varying laser power, scanning speed, and hatch spacing, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Process parameters significantly affect relative density, hardness, and wear resistance, with optimal parameters producing high-performance cermet.
summary_en.validation: Validation through SEM, XRD, hardness, and wear tests on fabricated specimens.
